_design_note:
The hybrid representation arm: route R09 = R07's trunk with handcrafted_v3 (62 entries) appended to the scalar branch (state.hybrid_v1), no D4. The three-layer trunk sees nine cells and cannot compute routing or reachability past a few, which the M3 line's vector already carries and validated block by block (docs/01 sections 7.10-7.11). THREE CHANGES against m4_r07_a06_e10_t02opp_oppbc, declared as three, because the calendar (code freeze 2026-09-21) does not leave room for one arm per factor: (1) the representation; (2) the clone's teacher -- the M4 oppbc submission checkpoint (docs/05 section 0.36) playing three rule_based on loot-crate, recorded with opponents on the board and with WAIT in the demonstrations (validation accuracy in the pretraining json), instead of rule_based solo; (3) the training table -- rule_based + frozen rainbow + frozen oppbc instead of three rule_based, so survival and kills are learned against neural bomb patterns as well (section 0.35: transfer comes from having seen opponents, not from the representation). Budget 15000 because the oppbc curve was still rising at 10000 (3.87 at 6000, 3.98 at 10000); the round-10000 checkpoint is evaluated for the comparison.

Clone: pretraining/models/r09_bc_oppbc_r07_loot-crate_vs3rb_hybrid_v1_150000.npz (sha256 dc58ed5cf1ed..., validation accuracy 0.841 against majority class 0.309).

_predeclared_design_numbers.changed_factor: Three against m4_r07_a06_e10_t02opp_oppbc: representation (board_egocentric_v2 -> hybrid_v1, D4 off), clone teacher (rule_based solo -> M4 oppbc with 3 rule_based), training table (3x rule_based -> rule_based + frozen rainbow + frozen oppbc). Plus the budget (10000 -> 15000), read off the same run.
_predeclared_design_numbers.control: runs/rep10k_oppbc (3.9844 on 3x rule_based, ten repeats) and rep_m4t_oppbc_* (3.0511 on the two unfamiliar opponents).
_predeclared_design_numbers.falsification: If the round-10000 checkpoint is not distinguishably above rep10k_oppbc on the proxy pool, the vector adds nothing a CNN with opponents did not already learn, and the submission stays oppbc.
_predeclared_design_numbers.prediction: Round 2000 above 3.5 on the tournament suite if the clone transfers as the rule_based clone did; coins above oppbc's 3.34 if the vector's routing reaches the head; unfamiliar-opponent score above 3.05. Kills are the open question: the frozen rainbow seat is the first hunting opponent this line has trained against.
_predeclared_design_numbers.reporting: All five training seeds; the 2000/6000/10000/15000 tournament checkpoints side by side; the proxy pool (scripts/tournament_pool.py) as the selection number, paired on the board seed against oppbc.
_predeclared_design_numbers.reproducibility: rule_based_agent seeds from system entropy; both frozen seats are deterministic given the board. Arms with opponents are not bit-reproducible.
_predeclared_design_numbers.selection_protocol: Pool the five training seeds at each checkpoint round; pick the round on the pooled VALIDATION curve; freeze it; then read the holdout numbers. The submission seed is chosen on the proxy pool.
